prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high, as no test achieved a statistically significant win.
Split-screen redesigns for adoption persona selection significantly worsened performance.
Adding background processing desktop alert systems significantly worsened performance.
Adding new screens, photo quality hints, setup checklists, or wait indicators showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in steps, layout redesigns, copy updates, and path choice redesigns showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -9.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.3% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -9.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -6.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.1% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -4.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.7% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Path Selection: Redesign the path selection screen into a card layout with distinct visuals for premade pet adoption vs custom pet creation. (why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users with an average wait time of 514s, indicating confusion between custom vs standard pet paths.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Reset Warning Hint on Sign-In: Add clear inline hint text on the sign-in screen warning users to use the same account to keep their existing pets. (why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after users sign in again with a different account.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Name and Trait Review Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming and trait summary screen right before the adoption certificate is generated. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the flow (60.9%) and takes a median of 89s, showing a need for a clear confirmation step.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Right Before Waiting Generation: Move the sign-in screen after pet choice and photo upload, immediately prior to the rendering waiting screen. (why: Signing in before choosing a pet causes friction; moving sign-in right before account save captures full context after pet setup.)
4: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Render Check Flow: Insert a desktop preview check flow during the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay permissions before finish. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling on startup.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Shortcut and Control Banner on Final Welcome: Update headline and body on home_intro to clearly explain system tray access, hotkeys, and how to summon/hide the pet. (why: 3 support messages report confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and 4 report desktop feature misbehavior.)
6: [home, wait_info] Story Scroll Layout on Waiting Screen: Switch the waiting screen to a story scroll layout displaying pet lore and setup status while generation completes. (why: The waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s) with an 18.7% dropoff rate before landing on home.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop System Tray Alert Notification on Waiting: Add an explicit system notification flag on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app during pet generation. (why: Users spend over 3 minutes median on the waiting screen, leading to high dropoff without notification assurance.)
8: [finish, redesign] Full-Bleed Layout Redesign of Home Intro Screen: Transform the home_intro completion screen into a full-bleed layout featuring interactive mascot elements and clear tray guidance. (why: 64.8% finish conversion shows significant dropoff on the final screen; a dynamic full-bleed presentation boosts completion confidence.)

scores.note: Path layout redesigns showed negative historical lift (-1.3%).
Addresses high email volume (8 tickets) with low-cost copy change.
New screens add friction and historically harm completion (-9.1%).
Reordering sign-in showed negative lift (-1.7%) in past tests.
Desktop permission flows and background alerts worsen conversion.
Low cost text update addressing multiple user confusion tickets.
Wait info changes showed consistent slight positive lift (+2.1%).
Desktop system notifications significantly dropped conversion (-6.9%).
Finish redesigns showed minor positive historical lift (+0.7%).
